title: Wired Article
description: A Wired magazine article as represented in RSS feed entries.

description.description: A short summary or excerpt of the article.

link.description: The URL of the full article on wired.com.

pubDate.description: The publication date and time of the article in RFC 2822 format.

author.description: The byline author of the article.

category.description: Category or topic tags associated with the article (e.g., Science, Security, AI).

guid.description: Globally unique identifier for this article (typically the canonical URL).

enclosure.description: Media attachment (image or file) associated with the article.

content.description: Full or partial article content in HTML format (from content:encoded RSS field).

thumbnail.description: URL to the article's featured image.
